WV11-P03.4.note: A roof described as having a 'steep pitch' in an attic refers to its slope; the pianist context makes 'tuning' a lure, but the word modifies the roof, not music.

WV11-P03.5.note: Read literally, her plain yes followed by playing the march at double speed while laughing shows amusement; nothing in her reply signals worry, thanks, criticism or wistfulness, and no ironic reading changes that.
